headline: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality announces postal ballot meeting for shareholders
hook: Postal ballot notice issued to shareholders
summary: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot. The company is seeking shareholder approval through remote e-voting for corporate resolutions. Retail investors holding shares in the company will need to cast their votes electronically within the specified window. This procedural governance filing has a routine impact on everyday market trading.
why_it_matters: Routine governance filing requires eligible shareholders to cast their votes.

headline: Supreme Holdings board approves related party transaction
hook: Shareholder vote sought for related party deal
summary: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited held a board meeting on October 28, 2026. The board approved a related party transaction, which now requires shareholder approval via postal ballot. The company has also finalized the draft notice for the postal ballot and appointed a scrutinizer to oversee the process.
whats_next: Postal ballot voting process to follow
why_it_matters: Shareholders must vote on the proposed related party transaction.
